newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian cabinet to meet Wednesday 0730 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Italian cabinet to meet Wednesday 0730 GMT.

text.p: The cabinet of Prime Minister Romano Prodi will meet on Wednesday at 0730 GMT to discuss a number of laws and decrees, the premier's office said on Monday.
A separate statement said Prodi and Agriculture Minister Michele Pinto will present to the cabinet the results of a commission formed to propose a reform of the milk sector.
The government earlier this year set up the commission to examine farmers' grievances over milk quotas and large EU fines. -- Rome newsroom +396-678-2501
